text: A boy comes to his father, the Prophet Yaqub, alayhis salaam.
"O my father, I have seen eleven stars, and the sun, and the moon... I saw them prostrating to me."
His father understood at once. This was no ordinary dream. And he knew his other sons.
"O my son, do not relate your vision to your brothers, or they will contrive against you a plan. Indeed Satan, to man, is a manifest enemy."
Then he gave him good news: your Lord will choose you, and teach you the meaning of dreams, and complete His favour upon you.
A dream of honour. A warning of danger.
And the danger was already closer than anyone knew.
